name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: Teaches an AI coding assistant to draw clean, magazine-quality diagrams for your docs and blog posts instead of the default boxy flowchart look.
buyer: A technical content marketer or developer-relations lead who needs good-looking architecture diagrams for blog posts and docs but has no budget for a designer.
business_use_cases: A dev tools startup uses it to make its documentation and launch blog posts look professionally designed without hiring a designer.
A freelance technical writer offers 'polished diagrams included' as a premium add-on to blog-writing gigs.
A consulting firm uses it to turn rough architecture sketches into clean diagrams for client-facing proposal decks.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a premium pack of extra diagram templates and styles beyond the 42 free ones.
Offer a 'diagram polish' service for technical blogs and docs sites as a subscription add-on.

steal_this: A 'make my docs look good' weekend service: take any team's existing Mermaid diagrams, run them through this, and sell the redesigned set as a one-off deliverable.
